features.title: 병원 진료 보기 — full real clinic visit flow at 광안 메디컬 의원 (번호표 → 접수 → 대기·호출 → 진료실 의사 상담 → 처치/주사/수액 → 수납 → 약국) + 건강검진 코스 (GwangalliClinic)
features.research: Owner (Korean): "가게 병원 상호작용 가능해야한다 진료도 볼수 있어야하고" — the hospital must be truly usable: you can actually see a doctor. Research the EXISTING systems first and build on them: ServerScriptService/GwangalliGameplay/Health (HospitalPrompt desk/doctor → HealthEvent 'clinic' UI; HealthRequest RemoteFunction ops treat / vitamin / checkup with fees and choreography: Health.findBed, nurse Motor6D syringe pose with GwProp parts, doctor seated pose; Player.Fatigue attribute; collapse → ward), its client UI (find the LocalScript that handles HealthEvent 'clinic'), Law/Hospital (NPC actors 접수/의사/간호사/환자/보호자 and their SPOTS), KOSystem/Arms ward wake-up, the ATM 번호표 client pattern (GwangalliFeatures/ATM), Interact 'vending', GwangalliWorld/Screens (LEDScreen Messages attribute), Bank (money), Profiles, Relationships. Survey: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user--/70cfab65-8cfb-5029-bbdf-07c69ae89ee1/scratchpad/bld/hospital_garage.json (hospital venue entries: rooms, gameplay contracts, interactionIdeas — 번호표 발권기, 혈압계, 체중계, 시력표, 청력 부스, 심전도, 정수기, 자판기, 커튼, TV, 호출 버튼, 약국 약봉투 ...). Also the second hospital 광안 종합병원 (runtime-built: GwangalliBuildings/Hospital + Builder/Hospital, ShopLife desks 원무과/응급실/외래/주사실/병동/약국) — note how its desks work so the flow can also run there if cheap. Another agent is building a client-only facility layer (doors/elevator/restrooms) in GwangalliBuildingInterior/HospitalPlus + Hosp_*.luau, and T_clinic.luau dresses the rooms (it builds static LED screens: 대기 번호 / 호출번호 displays) — read them to place your dynamic screens and avoid conflicts.
features.build:
Make 진료 보기 a real, fun, AAA clinic visit, built ON the existing Health system (never duplicate or bypass its fees/effects — call its HealthRequest ops for the real treatment/checkup/vitamin results):
1) 번호표 발권기 at the lobby kiosk: prompt → printed ticket pops out (client anim) with your number; server-side shared queue per 진료과 (내과 · 가정의학과 · 소아청소년과 · 예방접종 · 건강검진), visible to everyone.
2) LED call screens (lobby, waiting room, consult door): live '대기 N명 · 진료중 N번', '○○○님 (번호) 진료실 1로 들어오세요' with 딩동 chime and a TTS-free voice-like chime; render as SurfaceGuis in PlayerGui adorned to the room's screen parts (prefer parts with attribute GwClinicScreen in Workspace.GwInteriorDetailLocal, else the map's LEDScreen parts in the hospital, else your own small screen parts in your own Workspace folder).
3) 접수 at the reception desk (receptionist NPC from Law/Hospital if present, else the desk): dialog — 증상 선택 (감기·몸살 / 피로 / 두통 / 상처 / 예방접종 / 건강검진 상담), 진료과 배정, 대기 안내; a wait in the waiting room (sit on a waiting seat counts; magazine/TV/정수기 small interactions while waiting), time-scaled (~20–60 s, shorter when no one is ahead).
4) 진료실: when called, walk in; doctor dialog with a typing effect: 문진 (questions about symptoms), 청진기/혈압 check mini-sequence (camera close-up, BP cuff tween, numbers derived from Player.Fatigue / health state), 진단 card, treatment choice → 주사 · 수액 · 처방전 · 비타민 → route into the existing Health ops (treat / vitamin / checkup) so fees and effects stay real; the existing seated-doctor/nurse choreography plays; '진료 중' lamp over the door (publish an attribute the facility layer can show).
5) 처치실: 주사실/수액 recliner flow with progress bar and nurse lines; 6) 수납: 진료비 영수증 UI (itemised, 원), pay via the existing fee path; 7) 약국: prescription → pharmacist hands a 약봉투 prop (client) with 복약 안내 card; optional medicine buff only if the Health system supports it.
8) 건강검진 코스 (2F 건강검진센터): station by station mini-games — 신장·체중 (height rod), 혈압, 시력 검사 (Landolt C arrows), 청력 부스 (beeps L/R), 심전도 (ECG line) → 결과지 UI; final step calls the existing HealthRequest 'checkup'.
9) Ward/rest: '병실 휴식' on a free ward bed via the existing safe path, 간호사 호출 버튼 chime + nurse lamp.
Server: shared queues/tickets/state with validation and rate limits, cleanup on leave; never break HospitalPrompt anchors/prompts, HospitalBed seats, staff rigs, NPC corridors. Korean UI, mobile-friendly, premium clinic look (teal/white).
